summary: Full-stack test of 8-page React app. Backend: 19/19 pytest pass against public URL. Frontend: all 8 pages validated (home/games/activities/rankings/shop/intro/partners/user). Discovered and fixed one CRITICAL crash in GameNav.jsx (unguarded groups[0].id when API not yet loaded) causing /games page to be entirely blank.

issues: Sonner toast from Games page (tool-auto '开发中,敬请期待') persists visibly after navigating to /(home) — consider clearing/dedup on route change. Minor.

page-2 click loads next 20 real periods without console errors
game-tab-8 (北京28) switches activeGame, draws=[] → shows friendly placeholder '暂无开奖数据,等待服务端推送' (no crash)
GameToolbar: tool-help, tool-records, tool-mode, tool-trend, tool-auto all clickable; tool-auto fires sonner toast '开发中,敬请期待'
/activities: 5 activity-* cards, clicking first opens activity-dialog
/rankings: 3 rank-tab-*, 3 rank-top-*, 17 rank-row-* (top3 podium + 17 rows = 20 total); rank-tab-week loads new set

action_items: (Applied by tester) GameNav.jsx: added guard when groups=[] to avoid 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading id)' crash on initial mount before /api/games responds. Verify the fix is acceptable; alternatively lift the fetch above or pass a loading state.
Consider dismissing/deduping sonner toasts across route changes so the '开发中' toast from /games doesn't linger on /.
critical_code_review_comments: GameNav.jsx: previously assumed groups is non-empty (`groups[0].id`) but GameArena mounts with groups=[] and only fills after axios resolves → uncaught runtime error crashed the whole /games route. Always guard destructuring of async data.
GameArena.jsx: onSelect fires an info toast on every game switch which can feel noisy when the user quickly tabs; consider suppressing when same gid.
server.py seed_if_needed: idempotent via meta.seeded_v1 flag — good. But seed data uses hard-coded 2026 dates for activities/news; if this app was originally 2016, keep current dates for demo (OK).
Rankings scope 'all' or any unknown value silently falls back to seed=1 (day) — return 400 for invalid scope for stricter API.
All /api endpoints correctly strip Mongo _id via projection or pop — no ObjectId serialization issues.
AccountBar top-right shows demo user; consider hiding 退出/刷新 buttons or wiring them since they currently do nothing (minor).

success_rate.frontend: 100% after GameNav fix (was 0% for /games before fix)

seed_data_creation: None (server seeds itself on startup from /app/backend/seed/*.json).
context_for_next_testing_agent: GameNav.jsx now guards empty groups; /games renders correctly with 150 real 急速28 draws across 8 pages. Other 5 groups (北京/蛋蛋/PK/加拿大/韩国) intentionally have no draws → placeholder shown. All 19 backend tests pass against public URL. Sonner toasts persist across route changes — minor UX. Test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is a solid regression base.
rca of the issue: /games page appeared blank on first load. Root cause: GameNav.jsx line 30 accessed groups[0].id unconditionally, but GameArena initializes groups=[] and populates it asynchronously via GET /api/games. During the initial render window, groups[0] was undefined and threw. React logged 'An error occurred in the <GameNav> component. Consider adding an error boundary...' Fix: early-return a lightweight '加载彩种…' placeholder when groups is empty, preserving data-testid='game-nav-desktop'. Verified: /games now shows game-nav-desktop, 34 game tabs, draw-info-bar (55416/14/大/双), history-table with mixed status badges, and pagination with 8 numbered pages.
